title: Install a Python command-line tool with pipx on macOS
summary: pipx installs a Python command-line program in its own private environment and makes its command available in Terminal. Your system Python stays untouched.

aliases.text: install python command line tool mac
how to install pipx on macos
install python app on mac without breaking python
pip install command line tool mac global
поставить консольную утилиту python на mac
установить python утилиту отдельно от системы мак

prerequisites: Know the name of the Python package, for example httpie

steps.explain: Check whether pipx is already installed. If this prints a path, skip the next step.
steps.expect: Nothing is printed if pipx is not installed yet. If it is installed, a path such as /opt/homebrew/bin/pipx (Apple Silicon) or /usr/local/bin/pipx (Intel) is printed.

steps.explain: Install pipx with Homebrew. pipx itself gets its own Python, so the Python that came with macOS is not changed.
steps.expect: Homebrew downloads and installs pipx. On success a line starting with 🍺 shows the install folder.

steps.explain: Add the folder where pipx puts program commands (~/.local/bin) to your PATH, so Terminal can find them. This edits your shell settings file (for example ~/.zshrc) once.
steps.expect: Prints 'Success! Added' with the folder and tells you to open a new terminal, or says the folder is already in PATH.

steps.explain: Install the Python package. pipx creates a separate environment for it and makes its commands available everywhere in Terminal.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Name of the Python package that provides the command-line tool

steps.expect: Shows 'installed package <PACKAGE>' with its version, then 'These apps are now globally available' and the command names, for example '- http'.

verify.expect: A line 'package <PACKAGE> <version>' appears for each installed tool, with its command names listed below it. If nothing is installed, it prints 'nothing has been installed with pipx'.
